title: A maximal-mass action is Bayes under finite-class zero–one loss
statement: On a nonempty finite class, every posterior-mass maximizer minimizes zero–one posterior risk, and the least-indexed maximizer gives a measurable attained rule.
strategy: Compute the finite-class posterior risk and construct a measurable least-maximizer selector.

references.title: Ryan Martin, Lecture Notes on Advanced Statistical Theory, §5.3.1, PDF pp. 104–105
Andrew Gelman et al., Bayesian Data Analysis, 3rd ed., §9.1
